verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 at developers.notion.com/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable for the documented REST API. The llms.txt index with .md doc links adds further machine-readable material. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or versioning the spec, evidence that it covers the full REST surface (pages, databases, users, comments, webhooks, Agent APIs), and independent or hands-on corroboration that it is usable for codegen or agent tooling.
